text:
marco-partnerships: Heads up  Nitro Manufacturing just flagged a hold on 3 shipment batches for our reserved GPU orders (A100/H100 mix). They say a vendor-subcomponent recall is slowing final assembly. Could push some reservations past committed delivery windows.
nina-nitromfg: Apologies. We found a supplier lot with out-of-spec connectors. Affected batches: B-112, B-115, B-118. Earliest rework + QA estimate = 10-18 days. We can prioritize 2 customer orders per week for partial fulfillment if you provide priority IDs.
jules-sales: We have two high-risk customers: acct-cascade (enterprise reserved) and acct-hemisphere (marketplace co-sell). Cascade has penalties; Hemisphere is a launch partner.
tara-ops: Ops inventory shows we planned 6 racks for late-July rollouts. If we lose 2 weeks, that shifts several Dedicated activations. Need contingency.
leo-eng: Options we can offer quickly: 1) GPU swap to A10-class nodes (performance caveats), 2) route affected tenants to Hosted burst pools (higher cost), 3) stagger activations with partial rack delivery.
marco-partnerships: @ina-nitromfg can Nitro expedite one Cascade rack this week if we sign an expedite amendment?
nina-nitromfg: Yes, we can push one rack for Cascade with a 9% expedite fee and an acknowledgement of swapped serials. Need PO reference by EOD.
jules-sales: I'll ping Cascade. Meanwhile, billing: what's the net cost delta for hosted fallback for a month?
billing-bot: Estimated delta per 1 rack-month fallback to Hosted: +$18k (varies by model usage). Expedited single rack fee estimate: +9% of hardware cost (approx +$24k).
leo-eng: Note on performance: A10 swap shows ~40%-60% throughput loss on our large models; embeddings less affected. Hosted fallback increases latency ~15%-30% but keeps service continuity.
tara-ops: Ops action: prepare an Allocation Switch that routes up to 50% traffic to Hosted while Dedicated pending. Sample policy below:
```
allocation_override:
  - target_group: reserved-cascade
    fallback: hosted-us-east-1
    max_fallback_percent: 50
    cache_warm: true
```
marco-partnerships: Good. Jules, get Cascade decision on expedite vs hosted fallback by noon. If they opt for expedite, Ina needs PO by EOD. If not, we'll push hosted fallback + 15% service credit offer.
nina-nitromfg: Sending formal delay notice and QC summary to partnerships@redwood.com in 30m.
jules-sales: On the call with Cascade now, will update in 30.
tara-ops: Opening incident INC-2026-0724 to track this with owners and cost codes.
billing-bot: Incident INC-2026-0724 created  owner: tara-ops  priority: P2 
marco-partnerships: Thanks team. Action items: @jules-sales customer decision by noon, @ina-nitromfg formal notice + PO instructions, @leo-eng perf delta table, @tara-ops incident + allocation policy. We'll review in partnerships standup tomorrow. :eyes:
